package.description: QNAP QuDedup Extract Tool helps restore deduplicated .qdff

en-US.description: QNAP QuDedup Extract Tool helps restore deduplicated .qdff
en-US.longDescription: QNAP QuDedup Extract Tool helps restore deduplicated .qdff (QNAP deduplication file format) files to their normal status. Windows®, Mac® and Linux® (Ubuntu®) users can install it on their computers to restore .qdff files downloaded from a remote NAS or the cloud. The QuDedup Extract Tool also allows users to preview and select files before restoring them, while the granular recovery function allows for restoring specific folders or individual files, greatly improving the convenience and efficiency to access backed-up .qdff files.
en-US.name: QuDedup Extract Tool

zh-CN.description: QNAP QuDedup Extract Tool 应用工具可解析去重文件格式 .qdff
zh-CN.longDescription: QNAP QuDedup Extract Tool 应用工具可解析 QNAP QuDedup 去重文件格式 .qdff (QNAP deduplication file format)。Windows®、Mac® 及 Linux® (Ubuntu®) 用户可安装于计算机上来还原从远程或云端上所下载的 .qdff 档案，提升 .qdff 档案的可移植性。档案预览功能可让您预览并选择正确的档案进行还原；精细还原 (Granular Recovery) 功能更可让您针对特定文件夹或是个别档案进行还原，大幅提升取用去重复化档案的便利性及效率。
